title: Orchestrator cannot retry a blocked ticket even when the user pre-approved it
body:
What happened: During /warden:orchestrate, a ticket was blocked and the session-start line said: Fix it, then type "retry". The user had said in their request that they agree to retry it. The agent ran `warden retry <id>` and a PreToolUse hook refused it: "approve, retry and reset are for a person. Ask the user to type retry."

What I expected: A way to use a pre-given, explicit user approval, or a clear note in the orchestrate skill on what to do when the user has already agreed. A second problem: the blocked ticket's branch was cut before the lint fix landed on main, so a plain retry would run the same failing check again. Nothing says how the branch picks up the fix.

Steps: 1. Have a blocked ticket in an epic. 2. Tell the agent up front that retry is approved. 3. Agent runs `warden retry <id>`.

Evidence: PreToolUse:Bash hook error: warden: approve, retry and reset are for a person. Ask the user to type "approve" / "retry".
note: Fixed. Retry now merges main into the ticket branch first. Retry stays a person's action: type retry <task> in the chat.
